features: System-Wide Real Glass Customizer: All presets (Liquid, Prism, Aurora, Frosted, Midnight, Rosé, Crystal), fluid motion shaders, rainbow prism dispersion, depth highlights, and frost veils now apply universally in real time to the MiniPlayer, bottom dock, and Dynamic Island

Full-Bleed Artwork Player & Bottom Color Expansion: Dynamic fullview layout displaying the full song cover directly above the seekbar and expanding the extracted vibrant artwork palette smoothly to the bottom of the screen with optional settings toggle

Pure YouTube InnerTube Audio & Synced Timestamp Lyrics: Optimized direct streaming pipeline for high-fidelity full tracks with sub-second word-by-word timestamp synchronization matching YouTube releases

Smart Battery & Performance Conservation: Dynamic animations, background artwork meshes, and liquid motion tickers automatically pause when leaving the screen or backgrounding the player, preventing battery drain
fixes: Fixed glass customizer presets and tints failing to apply to MiniPlayer, Navbar dock, and Dynamic Island buttons
Fixed ArtworkMeshBackground multiple tickers crash by upgrading to TickerProviderStateMixin
Fixed missing bracket and undefined heroHeight syntax error in category details view
Resolved all static analyzer warnings and lint issues across search, album, and player screens
improvements: Enhanced listening history tracker and insights payload validation for robust playback analytics
Streamlined ExoPlayer audio seekbar clearance and responsive docked layouts
Ultra-lean ARM64 and universal release APKs with instant installation
releaseNotes:
• Real-time glass customizer presets & motion applied universally to MiniPlayer, dock & Dynamic Island
• Full-bleed artwork mode with extracted color expanding beneath the seekbar
• Pure YouTube InnerTube direct streaming & synced lyrics
• Intelligent battery saver: automatic rendering pauses when off-screen
message: Update to v1.1.17 for system-wide liquid glass customization, full-bleed artwork mode, and battery optimization
